limitations: The six recent diagnostic/main-after samples use different source SHA, binary SHA, configuration hash and performance cache identity; no matched source/tool/config/cache experiment exists. Fixed original successful before cohorts remain separate.

Only recent_diagnostic_cohort: 37411168218 and 37421759343 failed Windows Quality Performance Baseline and aggregate; Windows perf metrics are censored. Never use failed E2E as gains. All fixed original before runs are successful.
Only recent_diagnostic_cohort: Windows five-warm/cold before n=1; successful after n=3. Linux/macOS n=3 each.
Runner labels are stable but runner instance IDs and image builds differ; Ubuntu image for 377229 is newer and Python is 3.14.8 there.

Only recent_diagnostic_cohort end-to-end medians include failed before runs. Fixed successful before/after acceptance cohorts exclude failures. Summed runner work is overlapping execution, not elapsed wall time.
These six natural samples do not replace PR-event samples or other required GH-291 acceptance. Later natural main runs are supplemental and do not replace this defined cohort.
Build seconds are the cargo Finished release-small profile durations embedded in QPB logs, not a controlled compile-only microbenchmark.

coverage_and_tool_installation.interpretation: The original pre-change Code Coverage job and three post-change successful natural-main Code Coverage jobs were read from raw Actions logs. All use tarpaulin 0.37.5 and the same locked LLVM/Cobertura command. The first post-change result exactly matches 87.99%, 10248/11647; later source snapshots report 10249/11648 and 10249/11650 at 87.99%/87.97%. Installation shifted from source compilation (117.79s in the pre-change log) to checksum-verified prebuilt binary install (0.775s, 0.443s, 0.412s in three post-change logs). The Cobertura report was generated and upload attempted, but retained logs show the non-blocking Codecov upload rejected tokenless submission; the Actions step still concluded success. This supports effective-version, command/output and measured-install parity from logs, not byte-identical XML or successful Codecov service ingestion, and not causal total-CI speedup. PR Code Coverage was skipped and is not used.
coverage_and_tool_installation.artifact_scope_note: No quality-coverage-* artifact is associated with tarpaulin Code Coverage here. Those artifacts are separate Quality Coverage/Critical Paths LLVM source-risk outputs and are intentionally not represented as tarpaulin raw output or XML.

pr_after_comparison.caveats: All after heads have 62c3d30 as merge base (verified with GitHub compare API).
